title: Light Pappardelle with Mediterranean Sauce
description: A quick and easy pasta dish that combines vibrant flavors of the mediterranean. This recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Cook the pappardelle according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the vibrant over medium heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the light and cook for 2-3 minutes until tender.
Stir in the mediterranean and cook for 1 minute.
Toss the cooked pappardelle in the skillet with the sauce.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve immediately, topped with grated parmesan and chopped parsley.
